about_short_description.short_description: An open-source omnichannel customer engagement suite

product.name: Captain AI Agent
product.description: An AI assistant that automates customer support by learning from help center content, chats, and FAQs to answer common questions and assist agents with smart reply suggestions and translations.

product.name: Omnichannel Support Desk
product.description: A unified inbox that consolidates customer conversations from websites, email, social media, and messaging platforms into a single interface for streamlined support management.

product.name: Knowledge Base (Help Center)
product.description: A customizable knowledge base that provides customers with self-service access to answers and support content, organized by portals and enhanced with AI-powered search.

product.name: Live Chat Widget
product.description: A customizable live chat widget for websites that enables real-time customer engagement with options to tailor design, language, and behavior to match brand identity.

product.name: Developer APIs and Integrations
product.description: APIs and integration capabilities that allow businesses to extend Chatwoot's functionality and connect with external systems or chatbot platforms.

product.name: Team Collaboration Tools
product.description: Features that support internal collaboration among customer support agents, including shared inboxes, private notes, labels, and team management.
